messages:
Priya: apiserver 5xx spike in eu1 during GPU onboarding wave. controller-manager leader election flapping. pausing onboarding batch now.
Marco: logs?
Priya: etcd shows connection resets and leader switches: 
Priya: ```etcd: write: connection reset by peer
I0610 11:02:14.000000 1 raft.go:512] leader changed from 2 -> 0```
Alice: apiserver pods have high fd usage (~31k) and multiple restarts. kubelet probes failing with 503s.
Jia: checked nat nodes: nf_conntrack_count=32768 nf_conntrack_max=32768 -> conntrack exhausted.
Ben: provisioning opened thousands of attach requests in 30s. likely conntrack + apiserver fd exhaustion.
Marco: short mitigations: increase nf_conntrack_max on NAT nodes, bump apiserver LimitNOFILE via systemd, throttle provisioner concurrency.
Priya: implementing pause + will open INCIDENT-2026-0610 and assign SRE+infra.
Jia: rolling nf_conntrack_max -> 150k on nat nodes (10% first). monitoring.
Ben: hotfix PR to provisioner: add token-bucket limiter around attach workers (50 tokens).
Alice: applied systemd LimitNOFILE=65536 on one controlplane host. will roll if stable.
SRE Bot: ALERT: controlplane-apiserver-5xx eu1 breached (slo breached).
Jia: after first nat bump conntrack_count dropped to 22k, 5xxs reduced.
Priya: plan: 1) pause onboarding 2) increase conntrack across eu1 3) bump apiserver ulimits 4) deploy provisioner limiter 5) optionally failover new onboards to eu2 6) 30m monitoring then postmortem.
Marco: capture exact sysctl/systemd diffs in incident.
Priya: leaving this thread as coordination log. final: apiserver 5xxs returned to baseline, leader churn stopped, onboarding paused until next maintenance window.
